latestVersion.changelog: Harden guarded installs: validate inputs, remove scan bypasses, use private staging, require complete scanner results, and retain backups with rollback. Pin Snyk Agent Scan 0.6.3 and fix its parent-directory result handling. Adds regression and real-tool verification scripts. Requires Python 3.9+ and SNYK_TOKEN; authenticated cloud end-to-end verification remains pending.

raw_record.summary: Stage, scan, and install a ClawHub skill when the user requests a guarded ClawHub installation. Blocks installation on security findings or incomplete scans.
